links.outcome: ECG interpretation accuracy of ChatGPT-based models compared with cardiologists on same cases
links.effect: Cardiologists 92.52% vs GPT-ECGReader 57.94%, GPT-ECGInterpreter 62.62%, GPT-ECGAnalyzer 62.62%; differences statistically significant (p < 0.05), across all difficulty levels.
links.quote: Cardiologists demonstrated superior accuracy (92.52%) compared to ChatGPT-based models (GPT-ECGReader: 57.94%, GPT-ECGInterpreter: 62.62%, GPT-ECGAnalyzer: 62.62%).

screen.reason: The study benchmarks the diagnostic accuracy of ChatGPT-based models against cardiologists across 107 ECG cases without evaluating a deployment guardrail or practice.
